title: backlog.py landings prints each landing step's count, failures, median and 95th percentile duration
goal: bl_ops.step_stats(rows) gives, for each step name of the land.step rows, its count, its failures (exit not 0), its median ms (the mean of the two middle values for an even count) and its nearest-rank 95th percentile ms, and the same for whole landings under the name land.end; backlog.py landings prints one line per step from bl_stall.ops_rows of the clone, each line starting with the step name and holding median=MS, slowest median first, read only; kb/_self/tools.md and kb/_self/backlog.md name the command

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import bl_ops; rows = [{'event': 'land.step', 'step': 'rebase', 'exit': 0 if i else 1, 'ms': (i + 1) * 100, 'item': 'ST-aaaaaaaa'} for i in range(20)] + [{'event': 'land.end', 'exit': 0, 'ms': 5000, 'item': 'ST-aaaaaaaa'}, {'event': 'land.end', 'exit': 2, 'ms': 7000, 'item': 'ST-bbbbbbbb'}]; s = bl_ops.step_stats(rows) if hasattr(bl_ops, 'step_stats') else {}; r = s.get('rebase', {}); e = s.get('land.end', {}); sys.exit(0 if (r.get('count'), r.get('failed'), r.get('median_ms'), r.get('p95_ms')) == (20, 1, 1050, 1900) and (e.get('count'), e.get('failed'), e.get('median_ms'), e.get('p95_ms')) == (2, 1, 6000, 7000) else 1)

import re, subprocess, sys; st = lambda: subprocess.run(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout; before = st(); r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/backlog.py', 'landings'], capture_output=True, text=True); med = [int(m) for m in re.findall(r'median=(\d+)', r.stdout)]; names = [l.split()[0] for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if 'median=' in l]; sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and 'rebase' in names and 'land.end' in names and med == sorted(med, reverse=True) and st() == before else 1)

import subprocess, sys; r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/backlog.py', 'landings', '--help'], capture_output=True, text=True); t = open('kb/_self/tools.md').read() + open('kb/_self/backlog.md').read(); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and 'backlog.py landings' in t else 1)

One sprint's rows by a sprint id argument, like ops

notes: Premise (run 2026-10-22): backlog.py has no landings subcommand; backlog.py ops reads one sprint's rows only and prints them raw. kbmon --events on this clone gave 21 kb.land spans with 151 kb.land.step children; one landing (ST-bjwyl2bc) spent 49271 ms in kbgit.py-sync-push and 35169 ms in rebase of 115550 ms. The operator chose this stdlib summary on 2026-10-22 knowing ops and digest orchestration features were parked on 2026-10-07.
